reasons: § 12.4 binds Customer with a post-term non-compete of 24 months, undefined scope ('any product or service that competes with Vendor'), unlimited territory, and no acquisition or internal-development carve-out — squarely walk-away territory and failing the fallback on every material term.

Deleting § 12.4 is the minimal edit that reaches the preferred position (no restriction on Customer); no narrowing edit could salvage a clause this broad without rewriting it wholesale, and the comment properly offers the narrowed fallback.

Deletion creates no gap or inconsistency: § 12.3 already affirms Customer is unrestricted and that no non-compete commitment was made, so removing § 12.4 resolves an internal contradiction rather than introducing one.

Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, cites the playbook position and the § 12.3 conflict, and does not overstate; deterministic checks confirm no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.
